---
title: 'Event bookings'
description: 'Create ticketed events or appointments, publish a desk, invite guests, and scan admission codes.'
---

The Events API is a booking desk: create an event, sell or invite tickets, then scan an admission code at the door. Writes require **Booking** to be connected on the organization. Until it is, the API returns **403** with `Turn on Booking to use the desk.`

A start time with `capacity: 1` is an appointment. Higher capacity is a ticketed event.

## Workflow

| Step | Call | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create | `POST /events` | Requires `Idempotency-Key`. Returns the desk. |
| Add types | `POST /events/{id}/types` | Optional. Extra ticket or pack. |
| Publish | `POST /events/{id}/publish` | Omit `published` or send `true`. Send `false` to take the page down. |
| Invite | `POST /events/{id}/invites` | Emails tickets with no charge. Guest is saved as a customer. |
| Desk | `GET /events` / `GET /events/{id}` | Sold, remaining, scanned, recent buyers. |
| Scan | `POST /events/{id}/scan` | First scan admits. A second scan is already used. |
| Door PIN | `POST /events/door-pin` | 4–6 digits for the verify page. Not the payout PIN. |

## Create an event

`title`, `price_amount`, and `capacity` are required. Currency defaults to **XOF**. `price_amount` may be `0` for a free event.

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa/events" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: evt-night-market-1" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Night market",
    "price_amount": 5000,
    "capacity": 200,
    "currency": "XOF",
    "venue": "Plateau",
    "starts_at": "2026-11-14T19:00:00.000Z"
  }'
```

Constraints:

| Field | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | Required, max 200 characters |
| `price_amount` | Integer, ≥ 0 (minor units) |
| `capacity` | Integer, ≥ 1 |
| `venue` | Optional, max 200 characters |
| `ticket_name` | Optional, max 80 characters |
| `currency` | Optional, defaults to `XOF` |
| `starts_at` | Optional ISO timestamp |

A retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the first desk. Other event writes do not require that header.

## Ticket types

Add a named ticket or pack after create. `seats` is how many QR codes one sale issues (1–20, default 1). `capacity` is how many of that type can be sold.

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa/events/evt_EXAMPLE/types" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"General","price_amount":5000,"capacity":100,"seats":1}'
```

## Invite guests

Emails tickets with no charge. `count` is 1–20 (default 1). The guest is saved as a customer.

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa/events/evt_EXAMPLE/invites" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Awa","email":"awa@example.com","count":2}'
```

## Scan at the door

Admission codes look like `ADM_` plus 14 characters from `2-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z` (no `I`, `L`, `O`, `U`). Send that code, or a string up to 32 characters that contains it. A full verify URL is usually too long for `POST /events/{id}/scan`.

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa/events/evt_EXAMPLE/scan" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"code":"ADM_2A3B4C5D6E7F8G"}'
```

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| First scan | Admits the code |
| Second scan | Already used |
| `Unknown ticket` | Code does not match `ADM_…` |
| `Ticket is not for this event` | Code belongs to another event on this organization |

## Door PIN

`POST /events/door-pin` sets the PIN that admits tickets on the hosted verify page. It is **not** the payout PIN and it does not move money. The door phone stores the PIN in the browser. The API stores a hash and returns `{ "door_pin": "set" }`.

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa/events/door-pin" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"pin":"2468"}'
```

The PIN must be **4 to 6 digits**. A wrong shape returns `The door PIN is 4 to 6 digits.`

## MCP

Hosted and stdio MCP expose the same desk as **`lomi_events`**. Pass `action` (`list`, `get`, `create`, `publish`, `scan`, `door_pin`, `add_type`, `invite`). Write-action descriptions list the body fields. `create` still needs `header_Idempotency-Key`. See [MCP](/build/mcp).
